_comment: Chapter 6 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the parents at home (hub_home): a free full heal. S6 (docs/gameplay/23 §8): "How are things?" changes with the story (news_*: the latest chapter done).

text.zh_TW: 家裡的灶上燉著肉，整間屋子都是香味。媽媽：「坐下，先吃一碗再走。」爸爸在門口補屋頂，假裝沒在看你。
text.en: Stew is simmering on the stove and the whole house smells of it. Mom: "Sit down, have a bowl before you go." Dad is patching the roof by the door, pretending not to watch you.

text.zh_TW: 爸爸從屋頂上探出頭：「上面那個公主——是不是對你很好？……沒事，爸爸只是問問。」媽媽在廚房笑出聲來。
text.en: Dad leans down from the roof. "That princess up there, is she... nice to you? Never mind. Just asking." Mom laughs out loud in the kitchen.
